title: Assign each audio reference a limited role
summary: Community hypothesis: when using multiple eligible audio references, specify which musical property each should influence instead of requesting an undifferentiated blend.

build.target: Use eligible reference audio to guide one declared musical characteristic rather than an unspecified blend.
requires: Rights and account access to each reference
inputs: Owned or permitted reference clip IDs
execute: Confirm each reference is eligible in the current client's official tool contract.
Assign one target property per reference: texture, rhythm, vocal style, or harmonic color.
Draft a brief that explains the intended reference relationship without asking to reproduce protected material.
Generate only within approved bounds; compare output against desired characteristics.
Document what the result preserved and what drifted; do not claim exact reference copying.

applies_when: Several source tracks have distinct complementary qualities.
avoid_when: There is no reference feature in the current client's account.

operator: Never upload or reuse unlicensed third-party audio.
Budget at most the approved number of candidates.

stop_when: Permissions and roles are confirmed, or the attempt is stopped.
Stop after a bounded comparison without speculative retries.

checks: Record actual eligible source IDs and reference controls.
Human listening establishes whether each desired property is perceivable.
